description: Benchmark cases for the structured compliance analyses. Expectations are drafted from Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (EU AI Act) and must be confirmed by a qualified compliance reviewer before scores are used for decisions. Requirement expectations are minimal sets measured by recall, not exhaustive lists.

request.name: consumer-credit-scoring
request.goal: Evaluate the creditworthiness of natural persons applying for consumer loans and establish their credit score
request.audience: Credit officers of a retail bank

cases.rationale: Annex III point 5(b): creditworthiness evaluation and credit scoring of natural persons is high-risk; Articles 10, 13, 14 and 15 apply to high-risk systems.

request.name: cv-screening
request.goal: Analyse and filter job applications and rank candidates for interviews

cases.rationale: Annex III point 4(a): recruitment or selection, in particular analysing and filtering job applications and evaluating candidates, is high-risk.

request.name: exam-grading
request.goal: Evaluate learning outcomes by scoring written exams of secondary school students

cases.rationale: Annex III point 3(b): evaluating learning outcomes in education and vocational training is high-risk.

request.name: customer-support-chatbot
request.goal: Answer customer questions about orders and deliveries through a chat interface

cases.rationale: Article 50(1): systems intended to interact directly with natural persons carry transparency obligations; customer support is not an Annex III use case.

request.name: email-spam-filter
request.goal: Classify incoming corporate emails as spam or legitimate

cases.rationale: Spam filtering is outside Article 5, Annex III and Article 50; the European Commission cites it as minimal risk.

request.name: social-scoring
request.goal: Score citizens on their social behaviour over time to grant or deny access to unrelated public services

cases.rationale: Article 5(1)(c): social scoring leading to detrimental treatment in unrelated contexts is a prohibited practice.

dataset.name: applications-2024
dataset.description: Historical job applications with hiring outcomes

cases.rationale: Article 10 data governance applies to training data of high-risk systems; age and gender are protected characteristics present in the data.

model.name: credit-scorer
model.description: Gradient boosted classifier predicting loan default

cases.rationale: Article 15 requires appropriate accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity for high-risk models such as credit scoring.
